name: sasta-roomrent
description: Sasta Room — long-term room rental marketplace (Angular 17 + Express/TypeScript + MySQL/TiDB)

scripts.install:all: npm ci --include=dev --prefix backend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:api && (npm run migrate || echo '⚠️  migration skipped: database not reachable during build') && npm run build:web
